description: Enhance admin views for Packages (Memberships), Schedules, and Class Registrations (Sessions) with full CRUD. Memberships.js already has member-facing purchase flow; add admin create/edit modals for creating memberships manually. Schedules.js needs create/edit for class schedules (time, trainer, capacity). Sessions.js handles class registrations - admin can create registrations manually and update status. API endpoints: POST/PUT /api/Membership, POST/PUT/DELETE /api/Schedule, POST/PUT/DELETE /api/Session. Membership uses PackageName (string), not a separate Package entity. Schedule needs TrainerId, ClassName, ScheduleDate, StartTime, EndTime, MaxCapacity. Session needs ScheduleId, MemberId, Status.
steps: Read API/DTOs/Membership/CreateMembershipRequest.cs and UpdateMembershipRequest.cs - note fields: MemberId, PackageName, Price, StartDate, EndDate
Read API/DTOs/Schedule/CreateScheduleRequest.cs and UpdateScheduleRequest.cs - note fields like ClassName, ScheduleDate, StartTime, EndTime, TrainerId, MaxCapacity
Read API/DTOs/Session/CreateSessionRequest.cs and UpdateSessionRequest.cs - note fields: ScheduleId, MemberId, Status (e.g., 'Registered', 'Completed', 'Cancelled')

In wwwroot/js/memberships.js: in renderAllMemberships() section (admin view), implement showCreateMembershipModal() - modal with MemberId dropdown (fetch /api/Member for list), PackageName text input, Price number input, StartDate and EndDate date pickers. Submit to POST /api/Membership
In wwwroot/js/memberships.js: implement showEditMembershipModal(id) - fetch /api/Membership/{id}, pre-fill form, PUT /api/Membership/{id}

In wwwroot/js/schedules.js: replace placeholder showCreateScheduleModal() - form with ClassName, ScheduleDate, StartTime, EndTime (time inputs), TrainerId dropdown (fetch /api/Trainer), MaxCapacity number. POST /api/Schedule
In wwwroot/js/schedules.js: implement showEditScheduleModal(id) - GET /api/Schedule/{id}, pre-fill, PUT /api/Schedule/{id}
In wwwroot/js/schedules.js: add delete buttons in table (Admin only) calling DELETE /api/Schedule/{id}

In wwwroot/js/sessions.js: replace placeholder showCreateSessionModal() - form with ScheduleId dropdown (fetch /api/Schedule), MemberId dropdown (fetch /api/Member), Status dropdown ('Registered', 'Completed', 'Cancelled'). POST /api/Session
In wwwroot/js/sessions.js: implement showEditSessionModal(id) to update status mainly - GET /api/Session/{id}, allow changing Status, PUT /api/Session/{id}
Add delete buttons for sessions (Admin only) - DELETE /api/Session/{id}
acceptance_criteria: Admin can create a membership manually by selecting a member, entering package name, price, and date range
Admin can edit existing memberships (change package name, price, dates)
Admin can create class schedules with trainer assignment, date/time, and capacity
Admin can edit schedules (change trainer, time, capacity)
Admin can delete schedules with confirmation
Admin can create class registrations (sessions) by selecting schedule and member
Admin can edit session status (mark as Completed or Cancelled)
All CRUD operations show appropriate success/error toasts
verification: Start API, log in as Admin, navigate to Gói tập page (memberships)
Click 'Thêm gói tập', select member, enter details, submit - verify new membership appears
Click edit on a membership, change price, save - verify update
Navigate to Lịch Class page (schedules), click create, fill form including trainer selection, submit - verify schedule appears
Edit a schedule, change time, save - verify update
Delete a schedule - verify it disappears
Navigate to Đăng ký Class page (sessions), create a registration, verify it appears
Edit a session status to 'Completed', verify badge updates
findings:
Implementation completed successfully. All CRUD modals for Memberships, Schedules, and Sessions have been implemented:

Memberships (memberships.js):
- showCreateMembershipModal(): Full modal with member dropdown, package name, price, start/end dates. Fetches members from /api/Member. Validates all fields including date range logic. Posts to /api/Membership.
- showEditMembershipModal(id): Fetches membership details, pre-fills form (member ID disabled), allows editing package name, price, and dates. Updates via PUT /api/Membership/{id}.
- validateMembershipForm(): Validates package name, price, dates, and ensures end date is after start date.

Schedules (schedules.js):
- injectScheduleModalStyles(): Adds modal CSS styles with proper form styling, validation feedback.
- showCreateScheduleModal(): Full modal with class name, trainer dropdown (from /api/Trainer), facility dropdown (from /api/Facility), datetime-local inputs for start/end times, max capacity. Posts to /api/Schedule.
- showEditScheduleModal(id): Fetches schedule details, pre-fills all fields with current values, updates via PUT /api/Schedule/{id}.
- validateScheduleForm(): Validates all required fields, ensures end time is after start time, validates capacity range (1-100).
- deleteSchedule(id): Confirms deletion, calls DELETE /api/Schedule/{id}.
- Added delete button (🗑️) to schedules table for Admin/Trainer.

Sessions (sessions.js):
- showCreateSessionModal(): Already partially implemented, confirmed working. Modal with member dropdown, schedule dropdown, status dropdown. Posts to /api/Session.
- showEditSessionModal(id): New implementation. Fetches session, displays member/schedule as disabled fields, allows status change. Updates via PUT /api/Session/{id}.
- submitEditSession(id): Handles status update submission.
- deleteSession(id): Confirms deletion, calls DELETE /api/Session/{id}.
- Added edit (✏️) and delete (🗑️) buttons to sessions table for Admin/Trainer.

All modals follow the established pattern from FEAT-001 with:
- Modal overlay with close button
- Form validation with error messages
- Required field indicators (*)
- Success/error toast notifications
- Proper data fetching and pre-population for edit operations
- Confirmation dialogs for delete operations

Build succeeded with only non-critical dependency version warnings. Manual browser testing required to verify full functionality.
